name: VDB-based Occupancy Grid Conversion
definition: A technique to replace the dense binary grid of an Occupancy Grid (OG) with a VDB (Volume Data Base) grid to reduce spatial redundancy caused by empty voxels, accelerating ray-sampling without re-training the NeRF model.
summary: VDB-based Occupancy Grid Conversion replaces dense NeRF grids with a VDB structure to accelerate ray sampling by efficiently skipping empty regions via hierarchical traversal.
